instance.neo4j_schema.json: LOCAL graph, NOT production: schema 1.2, catalog_hash 7c3840b3d0be (the production snapshot plus TCGA), captured 2026-09-24 by NExtSEEK scripts/graph_schema_fallback.py (commit 8c6e0c70). It is the graph agent's committed fallback schema. 1180 Sample properties, because at schema 1.2 every attribute title holding a value is a Sample property; the vocabulary includes the TCGA study titles, which production does not hold. The 2026-07-22 bundle shipped a PRODUCTION capture of 2026-05-11 with 85 Sample properties.

neo4j_schema_vintages_seen.note: As of NExtSEEK origin/dev 926be1e3, chat_nextseek's context/ tracks ONE full graph schema, neo4j_schema.json, beside min_graph_schema.json (a hand-written parser-routing summary, not a schema dump) and neo4j_protocol_schema.json. The runtime stopped fetching neo4j_schema.json from the graph (689f00be); the committed file is the fallback the graph agent reads when the live catalog cannot be read, so it is still the file to bundle. Its 1180 Sample properties are the schema 1.2 shape, not the uncurated 200-property dump warned about below.

refresh: uv run --script scripts/refresh_context.py --check   (report staleness)   |   uv run --script scripts/refresh_context.py --from-dir <DIR> --write   (apply). Per-file provenance is in context/PROVENANCE.json.
note: Each curation project's lockfile records which bundled_date was used at /curate-init. NExtSEEK_API.yaml is NOT auto-refreshed; its claim that the flat upload format lacks ontology support is dated 2026-05-27 and must be confirmed with the API owner before anything new is designed around it. Not refreshed on 2026-09-25, on purpose: NessieAI's nextseek_api.yaml and min_api_endpoints_enriched.json are the chatbot's narrower copies, not newer versions of these. nextseek_api.yaml has 24 paths against this file's 41 and drops batch-upload/* (/curate-qc calls batch-upload/validate/), entity_tree/*, sops/download and people/current; the NessieAI endpoint list has 8 records and drops the sample create, patch, delete, advanced_search and parents_by_child_types endpoints. Both also carry sample identifiers outside the reserved 19MMDD synthetic band, which tests/test_identifier_exposure.py forbids in this public repository. One real change they record: the download endpoint's canonical name is now /nextseek_api/samples/retrieve/ (NExtSEEK 4cfd48d8); /nextseek_api/admin/samples/retrieve/, which scripts/report/adapters.py calls, stays as a deprecated alias on origin/dev.
